exec $WORK/bin/scope$GOEXE
stdout '^2 \[X Y\] 7$'

logos lint ./...

stderr -count=1 'main\.lgo:15:3: \[slop::discarded_error\]'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/scope

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Pair struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func Walk[T any](v T) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		n := 0
		const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
			if k := len(f.Name); k > 0 {
				n += k
			}
			_ = v.[f]
		}
		return fmt.Sprint(n)
	}
	return "scalar"
}

func Names[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		if out == nil {
			out = make([]string, 0, 2)
		}
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func concrete(p Pair) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Pair]() {
		if v := p.[f]; v > 0 {
			n += v
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Walk(Pair{X: 1, Y: 2}), Names[Pair](), concrete(Pair{X: 3, Y: 4}))
}

-- dirty/go.mod --
module example.com/dirty

go 1.27

-- dirty/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"os"
)

type Pair struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func drop(p Pair) {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Pair]() {
		os.Remove(f.Name)
		_ = p.[f]
	}
}

func main() {
	drop(Pair{})
}
